policy: Under the policy, a data subject has the right to erasure of their personal data when the data is no longer necessary for the purpose it was collected. A request to erase data must be honored within 30 days of receipt.
scenario: MeadowFit, a gym, collected member Jordan's home address solely to mail membership cards. Jordan canceled membership and the cards are no longer being sent; the address now serves no remaining purpose. Jordan submitted an erasure request on March 1, and MeadowFit deleted the address on March 20.
question: Did MeadowFit comply with the erasure obligation?
